snippet.title: JUMANJI: WILD ADVENTURES – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The new Jumanji: Wild Adventures game is HERE 🎮! 
Grab your crew and jump into the dangerous world of #Jumanji! 
Be ready for new threats because the Jumanji drums could strike at any moment!🗺️👹#JumanjiWildAdventures
